title: Opt-in Personal Mode: server-managed session cookie on a loopback-only lane; remote/tunnel ingress on a separate bearer-only listener
description: Personal Mode (opt-in PAIR_PERSONAL_MODE=local) delivers zero-friction local dashboard access without weakening authority. (1) personal-session.ts mints durable digest-persisted sessions bound to the canonical owner: auto-bind with one owner, explicit one-time selection across multiple owners, fresh operator:personal:<id> only when zero exist — never a silent merge; business eligibility is owner-scoped, stale preferences drop. (2) mission-control-server.ts adds the /api/personal/* lane (status/bootstrap/select-owner/business/logout) exempt from the MC gate but self-guarded by ingress classification + Origin proof on every mutation; a session cookie satisfies operator-class auth for other /api/* routes only on local ingress, pins the operator (conflicting x-operator-id fails closed 403), never satisfies admin/broker/outbox/artifact lanes. (3) classifyPersonalIngress requires the declared local listener port + loopback peer + loopback Host + zero proxy marks — Host spoof, DNS rebinding and proxied traffic classify remote. (4) serve-mission-control.mjs runs dual listeners when enabled (loopback session lane on PAIR_MC_PORT; bearer-only remote ingress on PAIR_MC_REMOTE_PORT); mode OFF keeps the legacy single listener byte-identical. (5) start-pair-live.sh routes cloudflared to the REMOTE port when enabled — the privileged lane is never tunneled. (6) UI-V2: SessionGate bootstraps before /app/* renders (zero prompts), session.ts owns personal calls, cookie-authed SSE (no ?token= under a session), eligible-business picker + auto-restore, connected-state Settings (token behind Advanced), operator chip bound to canonical owner. Live evidence: bootstrap bound operator:op:admin with eligible BIZ_01M5XNM908B9A18ZJ5MB7ZVCY7; cookie read 6 objectives; operator conflict 403; remote rejected cookie 401 + bootstrap 403; Host spoof 403; logout revoked; re-bootstrap auto-restored business; tunnel targeted :8790. Rollback: unset/off yields identical legacy bearer behavior.
